# CG-REQ-031: Request no longer accepts null

A request value that allowed null no longer does.

**Why it matters:** Requests sending null become invalid.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Requests](./#req) |
| Direction | request |
| Detects | `schema.nullabilityChanged` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> {where} no longer accepts null.
>
> Consumers sending null will be rejected.
>
> **Fix:** Keep the value nullable, or release as a new major version.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: 3.0 nullable removed

```diff
  openapi: 3.0.3
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, nullable: true}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Breaking, high. POST /x: the request body (application/json) no longer accepts null.

### Fires: 3.1 [string, 'null'] → string

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: [string, 'null']}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Breaking, high. POST /x: the request body (application/json) no longer accepts null.

### Fires: 3.0 nullable → 3.1 string

```diff
- openapi: 3.0.3
+ openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, nullable: true}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Breaking, high. POST /x: the request body (application/json) no longer accepts null.

### Does not fire: 3.0 nullable → 3.1 type array (equivalent)

```diff
- openapi: 3.0.3
+ openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, nullable: true}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: [string, 'null']}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

### Does not fire: 3.0 nullable without type removed (no effect)

```diff
  openapi: 3.0.3
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {nullable: true}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.
